# MailExel — Email Management Software

> MailExel is a professional, all-in-one email management suite for Windows. It lets users view, convert, migrate, and backup 150+ email formats including PST, MBOX, EML, MSG, and OST — entirely offline, with no Outlook or email client required.

## Product Overview

- **Name**: MailExel
- **Category**: Email Software / Utility (Windows desktop application)
- **Price**: Free download (no subscription, no credit card)
- **Platform**: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
- **Supported Formats**: 50+ email formats — PST, MBOX, EML, MSG, OST, NSF, EMLX, DBX, MBX, TBB and more
- **Export Targets**: PDF, HTML, RTF, TXT, CSV, Gmail, Office 365, Exchange, Yahoo, Zoho, IMAP, POP3
- **Users**: 500,000+ customers worldwide
- **Rating**: 4.8/5 stars from 1,842+ verified ratings
- **Performance**: Processes 10,000+ emails per minute

## Core Features

1. **Email Converter** — Convert between PST, MBOX, EML, MSG, OST and 50+ formats. Batch convert unlimited files. Preserves folder hierarchy, metadata, and attachments with 100% accuracy.
2. **Email Migration** — Migrate mailboxes to Office 365, Gmail, Exchange, Yahoo, Zoho, Thunderbird or any IMAP server. Supports delta sync and scheduling.
3. **Email Backup** — Schedule AES-256 encrypted incremental backups. One-click restore for individual emails or full folders.
4. **Email Viewer** — Open and preview PST, OST, MBOX, EML, MSG and 50+ formats without any email client installed.

## Common Use Cases

- Convert PST to MBOX for migration to Gmail or Apple Mail
- Convert PST to PDF for legal eDiscovery and compliance archiving
- Convert OST to PST when Exchange server is unavailable or corrupted
- Backup Outlook PST files before migrating to Office 365
- View EML or MSG files without an installed email client
- Migrate IMAP mailboxes between servers with zero downtime

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- Works 100% offline — no internet connection or cloud dependency
- No Outlook installation required to open PST or OST files
- Supports HIPAA, SOX, FINRA and SEC compliance archival via PDF/A export
- PST files larger than 2 GB are safely handled (overcomes ANSI format limitation)
- Free trial available — converts first 25 emails per folder without a license
